title: Beachland Ballroom & Tavern
venue_description:
Beachland Ballroom & Tavern - Akron's Premier Live Music Venue

Historic venue known for indie, rock, and roots music with a dedicated local following.

Live Music and Events

Regular open mics and showcases alongside national acts. Strong support for local musicians.

Atmosphere and Amenities

Intimate ballroom and tavern setting with full bar and great sound.
